dataset_name: FLEX - Flame Extinguishment Experiment (NASA Table IX extract)
dataset_scope: First 10 tests (FLEX-001 to FLEX-010) from the published NASA summary table; this is a transparent subset, not the complete FLEX archive.

sources.document_title: Detailed Results From the Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX), March 2009 to December 2011
sources.doi_note: No DOI is listed on the NASA NTRS record for this technical publication.
supporting_notes: Page 1 describes the first 284 tests and measurement types.
Page 4 explains soot-volume-fraction imaging capability and radiometer limitations.
Page 16 states that detailed droplet and flame histories/raw experiment data are available through NASA PSI (registration required).
Page 19 defines the Table IX columns.

sources.note: Official PSI investigation record and repository entry.

gravity_coverage.note: Do not treat the FLEX ISS data as lunar, Martian, or Earth-gravity measurements.

units_and_conventions.missing_value: JSON null means not reported or not available in this table; it does not mean zero.

gravity_condition.source_note: NASA report states buoyant flow was negligible for all experiments in this report; it does not provide a single numeric g value per test.

extinction_velocity_or_limit.related_observation: Visible flame extinction diameter and test-end classification are reported where available.

soot_volume_fraction.note: NASA describes HiBMs as capable of measuring soot volume fraction in soot-producing heptane flames; the summary table does not give a numerical soot-volume-fraction value.

radiant_heat_flux.note: NASA states the radiometers were not sensitive enough to provide reliable quantitative flame-radiation data.

flame_spread_rate.note: FLEX measured droplet combustion, not solid-surface flame spread.

parameter_availability.extinction_velocity_or_limit: No extinction velocity is tabulated. Visible flame extinction diameter and test-end classification are tabulated.
parameter_availability.soot_volume_fraction: NASA describes measurement capability for soot-producing heptane flames, but numeric soot-volume-fraction values are not in Table IX.
parameter_availability.radiant_heat_flux: Not available as a reliable quantitative measurement in this report; radiometers were insufficiently sensitive.
parameter_availability.cool_flame_dynamics: Qualitative cool-flame observations are discussed for selected tests in Appendix A; no standardized numeric cool-flame time series is provided in Table IX.
parameter_availability.peak_surface_temperature: Not reported in this dataset extract.
parameter_availability.flame_spread_rate: Not applicable to the isolated liquid-droplet tests in Table IX.

quality_and_provenance: All numeric values in records are transcribed from NASA/TP-2015-216046 Table IX, pages 20-21.
No values have been generated, interpolated, or inferred.
NASA's table reports ambient composition as mole fractions, not percentages.
NASA's table uses a dash where a measurement is unavailable or not applicable; those entries are null here.
The PSI record is the official investigation-level source; the NASA technical publication is the source for the numerical test table.

The published report states that the full detailed raw histories and electronic data files are available through NASA PSI; this JSON contains only the first ten rows visible in the published summary table.
